note: Channels operated by the distributors themselves. This project cannot notify anyone and never collects a bill or account number - these are the routes that can actually reach a customer. Every value is marked with how it was verified; anything unverified is null rather than guessed.

unified.description: The government's unified power-sector call centre. After connecting, press the digit for your distributor: 1 = BPDB, 2 = BREB, 3 = DESCO, 4 = DPDC, 5 = NESCO, 6 = WZPDCL.
unified.operator: Power Division, Ministry of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources
unified.verified_from: Bangladesh Sangbad Sangstha and The Business Standard reporting on the call centre launch.

alerts.hotline_verified_from: Widely published distributor hotline; not confirmed against a DESCO-hosted page during ingestion.
alerts.notes: DESCO's Online Customer Service Management System handles complaints and lists per-office contacts. You will need your consumer or meter number there - enter it on DESCO's own site, never here.

alerts.hotline_verified_from: Printed inside DPDC's own zone load-shedding PDFs as the call-centre number.
alerts.notes: Each DPDC zone PDF also prints its own NOCS office name and duty-room mobile number - open your zone's PDF from the results panel to get the number for your specific area.

alerts.hotline_verified_from: Secondary reporting on the unified call-centre rollout; not confirmed against a NESCO-hosted page.
alerts.notes: NESCO publishes load-shedding notices as scanned images, so nothing machine-readable could be extracted. Call the hotline or check the website directly.

alerts.hotline_verified_from: Secondary reporting on the unified call-centre rollout; not confirmed against a BPDB-hosted page.
Secondary reporting on the unified call-centre rollout; not confirmed against a BREB-hosted page.
alerts.notes: Rural supply is run by around 80 local Palli Bidyut Samity offices, each with its own duty room and its own notices. Your bill names your PBS - contact that office directly for the most accurate schedule.
Reachable through the unified 16999 call centre (press 6). No WZPDCL-specific hotline was verified.
